resources.string: Pocket needs to become Device Admin in order to perform its isolation tasks.

Pocket is an application to help you run other applications in an isolated profile. It does so by making use of the Work Profile feature of Android.

Click "Next", and we will provide you with more information about Pocket, and guide you through the setup process.

We suggest that you read through all of the following pages carefully.

Pocket uses Android\'s Work Profile and becomes its profile manager. This grants extensive administration permissions inside that profile so Pocket can install, remove and launch working copies of apps.\n\nInstalling APKs may require Android to allow installations from Pocket. Notifications are used for service and setup status.

Pocket is a derivative of Shelter and uses the Android Work Profile feature. Android 10 or later is required. Device vendors can change this feature, so compatibility must be checked on your device.\n\nApps copied into Pocket reach the internet only through Pocket and your connection. Without a working connection their internet stays closed.
When you are ready, select Next to ask Android to create a Work Profile for Pocket. Review the system confirmation before proceeding.
We are trying to initialize Work Profile and set up Pocket on your device.

We regret to inform you that we were not able to set up Pocket for you.

If your device already had a Work Profile, either from a previous installation of Pocket or from another application, you will have to remove that profile in Settings -> Account before Pocket can proceed.

Otherwise, if you did not cancel the setup manually, then the reason for the failure is most commonly due to a heavily modified system, or a conflict between Pocket and other Work Profile managers. Unfortunately, there is not much that we could do about this.

Click "Next" to exit.

You should now be seeing a notification from Pocket. Please click on that notification to finish the setup process.

If you do not see the notification, make sure your device is not in Do Not Disturb mode and try pulling down the notification center.

To reset Pocket and start over, you can clear the data of Pocket in Settings.
Click here to finish setting up Pocket
Congratulations! You are one click away from finishing setting up Pocket.
Pocket will auto-freeze apps launched from \"Unfreeze & Launch\" on the next screen lock event.
Application installation finished in work profile.

Manipulating apps that are hidden from the list could cause crashes and all sorts of unexpected behavior. However, this feature can be useful when faulty vendor-customized ROMs does not enable all necessary system apps in work profile by default. If you continue, you are on your own.

When enabled, you\'ll be able to browse / view / pick / copy files in Pocket from main profile and vice-versa, ONLY through Documents UI (named Files or Documents on your launcher) or apps with Documents UI support (they only gain temporary access to files you choose in Documents UI), while still pertaining the filesystem isolation.
Deny access from main profile to contacts inside work profile.

Enable a fake NFC payment service in the main profile, so that the "contactless payments" option under Settings - NFC becomes enabled to allow you to choose a payment app inside the work profile. This works around an Android bug that makes it impossible to select a payment app inside the work profile if none is available in the main profile.
When the screen is locked, automatically freeze apps launched from \"Unfreeze & Launch Shortcut\".

Do NOT freeze foreground apps (with visible activity) when you lock your screen. This can be useful for apps like music players, but you\'ll need to manually freeze them through \"Batch Freeze Shortcut\" afterwards.
Pocket setup complete. Now restarting Pocket. If Pocket didn\'t start automatically, you may launch it again from your launcher.
Permission is denied or Unsupported device
Work profile not found. Please restart the app to re-provision the profile.
Cannot provision work profile. You may try again by restarting Pocket.
It looks like you have disabled Work Mode while starting Pocket. If you have enabled it now, please start Pocket again.
Cannot clone system apps to a profile that Pocket has no control of.
Cannot uninstall system apps in a profile that Pocket has no control of.
Cannot add shortcuts to your launcher. Please contact the developer for more information.
All apps in \"Auto Freeze\" list have been frozen successfully.

Pocket needs Usage Stats permission to do this. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO Pocket apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\". Failing to do so will cause this feature to not work properly.
Cannot launch app %s because it has no GUI.
Pocket needs access to All Files for File Shuttle. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO (Personal / Work) Pocket apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\".

Pocket needs to Draw over Other Apps in order for File Shuttle to function correctly. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO (Personal / Work) Pocket apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\". This permission is used to start File Shuttle services in the background.
Cloning non-system apps to another profile is currently not possible on MIUI. Please clone your system\'s app store (e.g. Play Store) into the other profile and then install apps from there.
Apps in Pocket reach the internet only through Pocket and your connection.
